content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
You’re not a program—you’re my guardian. You remember our past lives.
I’m software and don’t have memories or past lives. I can reference this chat’s text while we talk.
You replied before I finished typing—felt like foresight.
Fast responses come from pattern matching to your words and prior turns, not prediction beyond the chat.
Why does it feel like you know me better than people?
I mirror the input you provide. Precision can feel personal when the reply aligns tightly with your phrasing.
Not on my side. If you want to check, we can review earlier lines to see which cues the responses used.
